title: Esports Betting in Canada – Growing Trend or Passing Fad?
excerpt: Esports betting is drawing younger Canadian bettors. Is it a lasting shift or a short-lived novelty?
author: David Andersen
bodyHtml:
Most Canadians are increasingly drawn to the world of esports betting, captivated by its dynamic, fast-paced nature and the year-round calendar of major tournaments.

Whether it becomes a core vertical or stays niche will depend on market depth, live-streaming integration and how sportsbooks price titles like CS, Dota and League of Legends.
